outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar chart of cell death (%) reporting the mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, but only bars with error bars are shown; the individual data points from the three experiments are not overlaid.
Panel B is a bar chart of cell death (%) with visible error bars, indicating averaged/replicated data, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a bar chart reporting mean±s.d. of three experiments at each time point, but only summary bars with error bars are shown; individual replicate values are not displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars shown on the averaged values, but the underlying individual data points are not plotted.
